title: W64 binaries outward-artifact proof
purpose: Prove the outward release artifacts are regenerated from canonical authorities and carry stable hashes.

P1_primary: Locate authoritative build entrypoints for XLSX, HTML, PPTX, and PDF outputs.
Record artifact paths, producing commands, input authorities, and expected output names.
Create a binary manifest that distinguishes generated outputs from source authorities.
P2_reverse_pressure: Reject any binary that cannot be linked to a canonical authority or generator command.
Detect stale checked-in generated artifacts that no longer match their authority inputs.
Flag dependency-bound outputs instead of falsely claiming regeneration.
P3_receipt: Hash every regenerated or source-verified outward artifact.
Emit a release artifact receipt with exact commit SHA, generator command, and SHA256.
Block release promotion if any required binary is missing, stale, or unhashable.

acceptance_gates: Every artifact has source authority, generator path, and SHA256.
Generated artifacts are not allowed to supersede SSOT authorities.
Exact-head CI must be green before W64 binary credit is claimed.
non_claims: Does not claim binary regeneration until commands execute successfully.
Does not promote W64 release readiness by itself.
Does not treat artifacts as engineering truth sources.
